name: monthly nth weekday: BYDAY=2TU across a DST transition
note: The second Tuesday of each month at 10:00 local. January 2026 has Tuesdays 6, 13, 20 and 27, so the second is Jan 13; February has 3, 10, 17 and 24, so Feb 10; March has 3, 10, 17 and 24, so Mar 10. January and February are EST (UTC-5) at 15:00Z; America/New_York enters DST on 2026-03-08, so Mar 10 10:00 local is EDT (UTC-4) at 14:00Z. The local hour is preserved and the UTC instant moves back one hour.
